title: Canonical protected workflow had no registered default-branch dispatcher

failing_environment.dispatch_result: HTTP 404 workflow not found on default branch

reproduction.observed: The self-hosted protected runner was online and idle, but GitHub exposed only workflows whose paths already existed on main; direct dispatch of control-plane-v5.yml on dev returned HTTP 404.

root_cause.summary: workflow_dispatch evaluates a requested ref only after resolving a workflow registered from the default branch. The canonical v5 path was new on dev and therefore had no registered workflow identity.

regression_propositions: the already registered assurance-full.yml path accepts every exact Control Plane v5 workflow_dispatch input
the registered path delegates to the canonical control-plane-v5.yml from the same selected ref
the canonical workflow supports both direct workflow_dispatch after promotion and workflow_call before promotion
the wrapper inherits the protected Factorio secret without duplicating execution logic
the final protected workflow still exposes exactly one MIR / verification-gate
C24, P9, and C30 package bytes remain unchanged

closure.proof_required: one protected C30 qualification dispatched through the registered assurance-full workflow identity and independently verified through seal and promotion
